summary: Using high-power lasers to drive highly magnetized plasmas, researchers have probed the stellar processes that control coronal mass ejections.

summary: The electronic properties of materials exhibiting giant thermopower with a thermopower that exceeds 2000 μV/K, such as EuCd P , are strongly temperature dependent.

title: Production and Decay Dynamics of the Charmed Baryon ${\mathrm{Λ}}_{c}^{+}$ in ${e}^{+}{e}^{−}$ Annihilations near Threshold
summary: Researchers observe the transverse polarization of the charmed baryon in electron-positron annihilations using the BESIII detector.

title: Bulklike Costless Domain Walls Driven by Phonon Pair Condensation in ${\mathrm{HfO}}_{2}$
summary: A previously unrecognized governing principle helps to explain the stable electrical properties in some ferroelectric materials like hafnium oxide.

title: Eigenstate Thermalization in Thermal First-Order Phase Transitions
summary: Researchers demonstrate that thermal first-order phase transitions require a generalization of the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis, leading to the coexistence of distinct eigenstate classes and Schrödinger-cat-like states.

title: Ghost Mechanism: An Analytical Model of Abrupt Learning in Recurrent Networks
summary: This study establishes the ghost mechanism as an underlying mechanism for abrupt learning, whereby the recurrent neural network develops ghost points—transient dynamical bottlenecks—and identifies ways to overcome the training instabilities.

title: Passive Quantum Error Correction of Photon Loss at Breakeven
summary: Researchers achieve passive quantum error correction at the “breakeven” point. Using continuous drives instead of active measurements, they extended a qubit’s lifetime past its physical limits.

title: Stretching Theory of Hookean Metashells
summary: A continuum theory that describes how mechanical metamaterials deform on surfaces takes the form of the Schrödinger equation and provides a different path for materials design.
